items.title: Alvin Alcorn Interview, 1976-01-25
items.q: But a guy came in a Pedder. I can remember. Sometime he got a tape in the 80s and released him.

ctx.x: Yeah. But a guy came in a Pedder. I can remember. Sometime he got a tape in the 80s and released him. The office picked him or something like that. But you could see where he had something. But it would have been better if it had been recorded. You know, that's the guy had mics and everything. They took him one of them and went to the world for a long distance. Wow.
When you mentioned funerals, that's something I'm curious about. Do you recall Armstrong playing any funerals back then?
